title: REQ · Typed manifest schemas cover id, path, type, dimensions, frames, animations, origin and bounds
summary: Zod schemas plus inferred TypeScript interfaces for the asset manifest
description: Context: no manifest types exist. Desired behavior: zod schemas defining an asset entry (id, path, type, dimensions, optional spritesheet frame info, animations, origin/anchor, interaction bounds) and a manifest wrapper, with TypeScript types inferred from them. Expected result: one source of truth for types and validation. Why: typed content contract.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid image asset entry, when parsed by assetSchema, then it succeeds
Given a spritesheet asset with frameWidth, frameHeight and animations referencing frame indices, when parsed, then it succeeds
Given an entry with non-positive dimensions or an unknown type, when parsed, then it fails
Given origin values outside 0..1 or negative bounds size, when parsed, then it fails
